## Version

Output of `git rev-parse HEAD` (commit) or the release tag you built from.
Snagline is pre-release, so there is no released version number yet — the
commit is required.

## Command(s) affected

Which of `snagline-control`, `snagline-delivery`, `snagline-edge`,
`snagline-front`, `snagline-dispatcher`, `snagline-buzz-projector`, or
`snagline-ssp-verify` is involved.

## What happened

A clear description of the incorrect behavior.

## What you expected

What you expected to happen instead.

## Steps to reproduce

Minimal steps, configuration, or input to reproduce the issue. Redact any
secret, private key, DSN, or credential before pasting config or logs.

## Logs / output

Relevant log output or command output. Redact secrets first.
